diego: Heads-up — while onboarding the new 64k-context qint8 build I hit a reproducible kv-index shadowing issue around position 32768. Outputs start repeating earlier context. filing initial notes here so we don't lose it.

lucy: can you paste the minimal repro + model config? which quantization pipeline (fbgemm/awq/llm-int8)? @diego

diego: AWQ pipeline, converted with our usual scripts. Quick repro (python):
```python
# simplified repro
from model_load import load_q8_model
model = load_q8_model('redwood/64k-q8-awq')
ctx = ' '.join(f"tok{i}" for i in range(70000))
out = model.generate(ctx, max_new_tokens=10)
print(out[:200])
```
Behavior: tokens 32760-32780 look correct, then at ~32769 we start seeing repeated fragments from 0..20.

ajay: I can confirm with the converted checkpoint — instrumented KV write logs show index mapping folding at 32768. snippet:
```
KV_WRITE pos=32767 idx=32767
KV_WRITE pos=32768 idx=0    <-- unexpected
KV_WRITE pos=32769 idx=1    <-- overlaying early positions
```

maria: hypothesis: kv-index is stored in a 15-bit field somewhere (or & 0x7FFF) in the quantized kernel/indexing path. RoPE uses absolute position phases; if positions wrap, you get phase discontinuity => output repeats. Also possible packaging hit in our fusion kernel where pos_id type was truncated when switching to int16 indices for memory.

diego: exact line looks like `kv_idx = pos & 0x7FFF` in the merged awq kernel (found in runtime bindings). Trying to trace why that mask exists — maybe leftover from older 32k limit.

lucy: can you try two quick experiments? 1) force `pos_offset=32768` at generation start (shift inputs) and see whether outputs shift accordingly; 2) disable caching (fallback to full recompute) to see if it's kv-cache-specific.

diego: ran both: disabling cache removes the repeat (so quality fine but cost spikes). forcing pos_offset moves the repeat window correspondingly (so it's definitely a positional index mapping issue).

ajay: reproducer attached to my run — I added a unit test that writes unique per-pos markers into KV and then reads back after stepping. It fails at pos 32768. I also dumped the compiled kernel symbol map — there is a comment `// legacy 15-bit pos` in awq_index.cu.

maria: two attack vectors: (A) expand kv index type to 32-bit on write/read (plumb through runtime) — more memory but simple and safe; (B) patch kernel to keep modulo semantics but update RoPE to be wrap-aware (compute rotary with pos % wrap and add continuous phase correction) — tricky; (C) short-term: detect when pos >= wrap and disable prefix cache + trigger canary fallback to fp16.

diego: opened PR  (https://stash/redwood/infra/pull/987) with a minimal change: bump index type in awq_index to uint32 and updated bindings. CI shows compile but not yet full regressions.

ci-bot: build queued for PR 987. gcc-toolchain: ok, CUDA: ok, unit tests: 214/215 passed (kv-index-test failed) — more logs at https://ci/redwood/987/logs

eval-bot: ran long-context eval suite (LLMEval-64k) on the canary with index-bump patch: perplexity delta +0.2 (within noise) but code-completion F1 drops 3.7% in the 32750-32790 slice. Qualitative check shows some outputs still correspond to pre-wrap tokens.

lucy: interesting — that suggests some layers still using old index size (partial ABI mismatch). Can you run `nm` on the runtime libs and check symbol versions? Also check saved KV index tensors in the checkpoint: maybe serialization used a packed format.

ajay: found serialization layer packing `pos_idx` as uint16 in our older checkpoint schema (v2). When loading v2 -> v3 we didn't migrate that field for awq models. So combination of older checkpoint + new kernel could cause mixed behavior in-mem.

maria: plan: 1) add migration step to convert serialized pos_idx -> 32-bit on load for any model with >32k pos; 2) add unit test to fuzz position boundaries (every 1k up to 65k) to catch wrap early; 3) add eval harness alert for slice-based regressions around wrap points.

diego: created a canary image with migration + index bump, ran a smoke job on Dedicated GPU pool — build id canary-2026-03-19-08: log: `migration applied: converted 8M pos_idx entries to uint32`

ci-bot: canary build completed but onnx export failed for one quantized path (tensor type mismatch).

eval-bot: re-run long-context tests on canary-2: PPL stable, code-completion F1 restored to within 0.5% of baseline. Added regression alert entry: RG-ml-2026-kwrap-1.

lucy: next steps: land migration + index type bump, add checkpoint schema version assertion on load, add targeted eval slices (wrap windows) to our daily eval job. Also scheduler: run A/B on 2% prod traffic for a week before full rollout.

diego: I'll follow up with the exact reproducer and attach the failing checkpoint. tagging @maria @ajay for reviewer. Thanks all :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — nice catch. documenting retro steps in the onboarding doc and adding a short blurb to "model-bringup-checklist.md" about position index types.

ajay: I'll add the fuzz test and the CI gate for kv-index-test before merge.

diego: done for now, will post logs & PR links in thread when available.
